jobs.placement: Homepage care-skin / PRP skin and hair
concepts: Warm window portrait of a 19-year-old Persian woman with clear natural skin and dense healthy dark hair, gently gathering her hair over one shoulder; square waist-up crop, cream and slate palette.
Cool dressing-area portrait of a 19-year-old Persian woman checking her strong wavy hair in a narrow mirror while her clean face remains fully visible; medium teal, blush and stone palette.
Balanced simple-studio portrait of a 19-year-old Persian woman with a long glossy braid and understated smile, seated with a blank consultation folder; rose plaster and mineral-teal accents.
jobs.selectionReason: The warm window portrait puts both the clean face and strong hair inside every crop without implying a treatment result.
jobs.complexion: light cool-neutral Persian skin with natural pink-beige variation
jobs.beautyStyling: natural; untouched brows, natural lashes, restrained lips and soft cheeks
jobs.lightSource: direct late-afternoon sun from camera-left, softened by a sheer window
jobs.lightEffect: warm forehead and cheek highlights, a crisp-to-soft nose shadow, bright hair-edge separation and cooler room-side shadow; no skin bleaching
jobs.palette: cream 65%, slate blue 25%, terracotta 8%, restrained champagne 2%
jobs.alt: دختر ۱۹ ساله با پوست طبیعی و موهای پرپشت تیره در نور گرم کنار پنجره
jobs.review: Accepted: fair cool-neutral skin retains pores and tonal variation; late sun creates clear cheek shadow and hair rim; dense hair and natural hand are crop-safe; no text.

concepts: Young Persian woman with abundant curls held back by a slim scarf headband, preparing a simple skincare routine beside a mineral-teal mirror; three-quarter portrait, cool daylight.
Close portrait against rose plaster, curly hair framed by a patterned headband scarf, one hand near an unbranded moisturizer jar; balanced light and cream clothing.
Seated dressing-area portrait with curls and a narrow silk headband scarf, closing a small skincare pouch; warm wood, slate wall and terracotta knit.
jobs.selectionReason: The dressing-area skincare moment makes the requested curly hair and scarf headband visible while staying relevant to skin quality.
jobs.complexion: warm bronze Persian skin with golden-olive undertone
jobs.beautyStyling: polished; shaped dark brows, visible mascara and curled lashes, fine brown eyeliner, restrained lips and cheeks
jobs.lightSource: large cool north-facing window from camera-right with a warm vanity practical behind
jobs.lightEffect: cool soft falloff across the face, warm rim on curls and headband, defined catchlights and dimensional bronze skin without orange cast
jobs.palette: stone 60%, mineral teal 27%, dusty rose 10%, champagne 3%
jobs.alt: زن جوان با موهای فر و روسری باریک به شکل تل، کنار آینه در حال آماده‌شدن برای مراقبت پوست
jobs.review: Accepted: warm bronze complexion, defined brows/lashes, scarf headband and curls are distinct; cool window and warm practical separate the face and hair; jar and hands are plausible; no text.

concepts: Happy older teenage Persian girl, age 18, in an open shaded courtyard, naturally smiling with loose curls and a plum overshirt; cream architecture and olive accent.
Bright simple-studio portrait of an 18-year-old Persian girl laughing softly, shoulder-length dark hair, rose backdrop and blue-gray blouse; clean square crop.
Seated window portrait of an 18-year-old Persian girl with a relaxed happy expression, dark braid and terracotta cardigan; pale blue wall and balanced daylight.
jobs.selectionReason: The courtyard scene feels youthful and genuinely happy without reading as a school or treatment scene.
jobs.complexion: medium olive Persian skin with neutral-golden undertone
jobs.beautyStyling: natural and age-appropriate; full natural brows, uncoated lashes, no contour, clear lip balm
jobs.lightSource: open courtyard shade with a narrow sun bounce from cream paving below
jobs.lightEffect: bright open catchlights, soft under-chin fill, subtle sunlit rim through loose curls and gentle olive-skin modeling
jobs.alt: دختر نوجوان ایرانی با لبخند طبیعی و موهای تیره در حیاط روشن
jobs.review: Accepted: youthful happy Persian subject with medium-olive skin, natural styling and open-shade sun bounce; no school cues, text or anatomy defects in the intended crop.

concepts: Beauty-and-regeneration still life: a translucent porous biomaterial sheet in a glass dish beside an unbranded serum bottle and curved mirror, blush and mineral-teal light.
Macro editorial scene of layered translucent skin-like hydrogel ribbons around a clear glass vessel, cream stone surface, rose and slate accents.
Elegant research workbench with a small tissue scaffold sample under glass, a blank notebook and understated beauty applicator, warm directional light.
jobs.selectionReason: The glass-dish biomaterial still life connects regenerative research and beauty directly without using an unrelated person or claiming a result.
jobs.selected: Biomaterial, serum and mirror still life
jobs.lightSource: large diffused studio key from upper-left with a narrow mineral-teal edge light
jobs.lightEffect: clean glass refraction, soft scaffold translucency, controlled mirror highlight and grounded contact shadows
jobs.alt: نمونه زیست‌ماده شفاف در ظرف شیشه‌ای کنار سرم بی‌نشان و آینه خمیده
jobs.review: Accepted: porous biomaterial, glass dish, unbranded serum and curved mirror clearly connect regenerative research with beauty; refraction and shadows are plausible; no text.

concepts: Scientifically grounded macro visualization of small purple-gold platelets among larger red blood cells in plasma, shallow depth and clean dark background.
Top-down laboratory still life of a blood smear slide under a microscope with platelet-rich plasma layer visible in a clear tube, no labels.
Editorial medical rendering of activated platelet fragments forming a delicate fibrin mesh, rose, garnet and champagne tones.
jobs.selectionReason: The macro cell view remains readable in the narrow card crop and immediately identifies platelets rather than a generic portrait.
jobs.lightSource: cool directional microscope-style illumination from above with warm grazing highlights
jobs.lightEffect: small platelet fragments remain distinct from larger red cells with dimensional edges and controlled depth
jobs.palette: deep garnet, rose, muted violet and champagne highlights
jobs.alt: نمای نزدیک علمی از پلاکت‌های کوچک میان گلبول‌های قرمز خون
jobs.review: Accepted as scientific editorial visualization: small granular platelet cluster is distinct from larger biconcave red cells and remains readable in a narrow card crop; no labels.

concepts: Top-down real laboratory photograph of a transparent cell-culture dish with visible cell colonies, gloved hand and pipette at the edge, no text.
Close microscope-side still life with a culture flask, softly visible cell colonies and a blank research notebook, cool slate and rose light.
Scientific macro visualization of living skin cells spreading across a translucent culture surface, pale rose membranes and teal background.
jobs.selectionReason: The culture dish is a plausible, concrete representation of living cells and works clearly at thumbnail size.
jobs.lightSource: cool laboratory task light from upper-right with soft bounced fill
jobs.lightEffect: cell colonies and glass meniscus read clearly while pipette, dish and bench retain realistic shadows
jobs.palette: slate blue 55%, clear glass 25%, muted rose 15%, restrained metal 5%
jobs.alt: ظرف کشت سلولی شفاف با کلونی‌های سلولی روی میز آزمایشگاه
jobs.review: Accepted: culture dish, adherent cell colonies, gloved hand and pipette form a credible laboratory scene; glass and shadows are coherent; no readable labels.

concepts: Accurate scientific visualization of a cell membrane releasing many tiny extracellular vesicles into surrounding fluid, no labels or text.
Microscope-inspired field of nanoscale translucent vesicles clustered near a larger living cell, mineral teal and warm rose palette.
Laboratory still life of purified extracellular-vesicle research samples in clear microtubes beside a microscope, labels turned away.
jobs.selectionReason: The membrane-release visualization explains what exosomes are at a glance and differs clearly from the cell-therapy card.
jobs.lightSource: balanced translucent backlight with a soft rose side key
jobs.lightEffect: membrane depth and tiny vesicles separate clearly without neon glow or loss of scale hierarchy
jobs.palette: mineral teal, translucent pearl, blush and soft violet
jobs.alt: نمای علمی از غشای سلول و وزیکول‌های بسیار ریز آزادشده در اطراف آن
jobs.review: Accepted as scientific editorial visualization: budding membrane and released extracellular vesicles have a clear scale hierarchy and strong narrow-card crop; no labels.

concepts: Close mirror portrait of an adult Persian woman gently examining mild cheek blemishes while parting hair at the temple, both skin and hair concern visible in one frame.
Over-shoulder bathroom mirror scene showing an adult woman inspecting a widened hair part with mild natural skin redness, cool daylight and minimal props.
Seated close portrait holding a small hand mirror, one hand at the hairline and natural acne texture visible, rose wall and cream blouse.
jobs.selectionReason: The mirror portrait communicates a real skin-and-hair concern immediately, with no school or arrival narrative.
jobs.selected: Close mirror portrait with skin and hair concerns
jobs.complexion: deeper warm bronze Persian skin with red-brown undertone and visible natural tone variation
jobs.beautyStyling: natural; full unshaped brows, natural lashes, no foundation over mild blemishes, unpainted lips
jobs.lightSource: cool bathroom window from camera-left mixed with a modest warm ceiling practical
jobs.lightEffect: cool cheek highlight, warm shadow transition, visible skin texture and a narrow rim separating dark hair from the background
jobs.alt: زن جوان مقابل آینه در حال بررسی جوش‌های ملایم گونه و خط رویش مو
jobs.review: Accepted: deeper bronze natural skin, mild cheek blemishes and hairline inspection communicate the concern immediately; mixed light preserves texture; hands and partial reflection are coherent.

Over-shoulder view of a doctor reading a paper file at a tidy desk with a closed laptop and pen, balanced cream and teal palette.

jobs.selected: Doctor reviewing patient file at desk

Close tabletop scene of two pairs of hands agreeing on a care plan beside a calendar, phone reminder and pen, faces softly visible above.
Patient leaving a consultation with a small appointment card while the doctor gestures to the next-step plan, warm corridor and relaxed expressions.

jobs.selected: Doctor and patient reviewing care plan and calendar
jobs.complexion: patient has fair warm-neutral skin; doctor has medium olive skin

jobs.lightEffect: warm highlights on the patient's styled face and hands, cooler contour on the doctor, readable calendar and dimensional mixed-light separation
jobs.alt: پزشک و مراجعه‌کننده در حال مرور برنامه مراقبت و زمان پیگیری
jobs.review: Accepted: doctor and highly enhanced but plausible patient review a shared plan and calendar; fuller lips, defined brows/lashes and mixed warm/cool light are visible; no readable personal data.

jobs.placement: Homepage journal feature / what is regenerative medicine
concepts: Macro editorial photograph of a translucent porous tissue scaffold in a glass Petri dish with delicate cell-culture pattern, elegant rose and teal lab light.
Research bench with a thin skin-like biomaterial sample held by fine forceps above a culture dish, clean cream background and deep plum accent.
Microscopic-inspired living tissue pattern transitioning from sparse cells to organized layers, cinematic editorial rendering without labels.
jobs.selectionReason: The tissue scaffold and cell pattern directly express regenerative medicine and read strongly beneath the cover title gradient.
jobs.lightSource: controlled studio macro key from upper-left with soft mineral-teal backlight through the glass dish
jobs.lightEffect: porous structure, cell pattern and glass rim remain distinct under the cover gradient with elegant but non-magical translucency

jobs.review: Accepted: tissue scaffold and attached cell pattern directly express regenerative medicine; glass, forceps and directional macro light are coherent; central crop supports the cover title.
